title: Microcontroller code templates
summary: Short code templates in both Arduino C++ and MicroPython: blink and serial, debounced button, battery voltage through a divider, low-voltage disconnect, DS18B20 thermostat relay, PWM through a MOSFET, I2C scanner and ESP32 deep sleep. Each gives the wiring in one line and the pins as constants at the top.

steps.text: Pick the template, set the pin constants at the top for your board, and check the wiring line before you power up.
steps.warn: Never put more than 3.3 V on a 3.3 V board's pins, and keep relays to low-voltage DC: mains wiring can kill. Unplug everything while you wire.

steps.text: Start with template 1 to prove the board, cable and serial monitor work, then add one part at a time.
Drive motors, relays and lamps through a MOSFET or relay module, never straight from a pin, with a diode across any motor.
